human_tolerance.notes: Authored. Wikipedia says song changes with human activity and noise; nesting in gardens and urban shrubs is not sourced here.

phases.name: nesting
phases.note: Authored window for the whole US range; coastal and southern populations start earlier and high-elevation or northern ones later. Not sourced to a permissive dataset.

phases.name: flocking
phases.note: Wikipedia: in winter they often forage in flocks.

vocalizations.description: Clear whistled song of a few phrases, sung from an exposed perch, given in every season and more often in spring.
Short sharp call given when alarmed from a low perch in shrub cover.

range.note: Breeds across northern Canada and the western US; northern birds winter south to central Mexico. Country list derived from that prose.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Fly from short flights to catch insects. Hop is authored (ground foraging, see behavior).

traits.flight.note: Powered flight; short flights in foraging.

traits.nest_type.note: Wikipedia: nests low in bushes or on the ground under shrubs. Cup form is an authored classification.

traits.perching.note: Passerine; forages and perches in low vegetation. Classification is authored.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Derived from annual adult survival, not measured lifespan. For each of three Dryad rows, mean adult lifetime -1/ln(s): s=0.492 (Desante 2015, labelled US, coordinates in Saskatchewan) -> 1.41 y; s=0.618 (Phillips 2018, San Francisco) -> 2.08 y; s=0.578 (Phillips 2018, Point Reyes) -> 1.82 y; mean 1.77 y. Assumes constant adult survival and exponential mortality. First-year mortality is excluded, so this is adult-stage expected lifetime, not life expectancy at birth; the robin's 1.1 y is a different statistic. Low confidence.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits BirdFuncDat row for Zonotrichia leucophrys: Diet-Seed 70, Diet-Fruit 10, Diet-Inv 10, Diet-PlantO 10. Diet-PlantO mapped to browse because the schema has no plant-other key. Wikipedia: 'mainly eat seeds, other plant parts and insects'.

traits.social.note: Structure Flock from 'in winter, they often forage in flocks'. group_size [2, 30] is judgement.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Authored judgement: diurnal songbird. Not stated in a checked source.

traits.defense.note: Authored judgement: flees to shrub cover.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits ForStrat-ground 80; understory 10 and midhigh 10 mapped to arboreal 0.2.

habitat.resources.note: Wikipedia: forage on ground or low vegetation; nest low in bushes or on the ground under shrubs. Weights are authored.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Adapter is judgement. Wikipedia: song is affected by human noise and activity.

seasonal.strategy.note: PartialMigration: southerly Rocky Mountain and coastal populations largely resident; northern breeders migrate.

seasonal.phases.note: Authored nesting window 04-01 to 07-31 for the whole US range. No permissive source gave nesting months. Wikipedia gives only general timing. Flocking window from 'in winter'.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Egg, juvenile and adult, following the robin record.

behavior.note: Species-local bt-zonotrichia-leucophrys-v1, copied from bt-perching-songbird-v1 with these changes: (1) nest month_in hardcoded to [4,5,6,7] because the shared program's nest params are two-value sets and cannot express a window; (2) a seed-eating branch added because diet is 70% seed and the shared program only eats invertebrates; (3) the shared cooldown re-perch and idle fallbacks replaced by wander at hop gait, since a ground forager should not fly to a perch every 6 s when not hungry. Hop gait for foraging and wandering is authored. Song only in the sun -6..12 degree window (shared condition), so midday song is not modelled.

look.note: Judgement: blocky model with a crown stripe and grey breast. Not measured from a specimen.

seasonal.winter_fraction.note: Authored judgement, not sourced. No checked source gives the winter share. Southern Rocky Mountain and coastal birds are largely resident; northern breeders migrate. The Dryad rows label the WCS sites 'migrant' but give no share.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Shrub cover from Wikipedia: nests low in bushes or under shrubs. Shelter tag choice is authored.

vocalizations.song.note: Authored description. No recording checked; song is affected by human noise per Wikipedia.
